fields.statement: At 81427c0d, go test -trimpath -count=1 -run TestRoadmap -v ./internal/web/ passes (TestRoadmapPageMatchesTheOperation, TestRoadmapPageEmptyAndNoAPI), as does the whole internal/web package; go vet and gofmt are clean. The test builds a fixture with two milestones, a backlog change set and an umbrella, checks the roadmap operation returns milestone, milestone, backlog, umbrella, then asserts /roadmap shows the titles and change sets in that order with the umbrella labelled Umbrella after the backlog, a /changes/<id> link and a state pill for each change set, no IDs or handles, a kicker counting 2 milestones (umbrella excluded), and a live fragment that picks up a newly planned change set. Read the diff: RoadmapView now keeps the operation's groups in order instead of splitting milestones and backlog, which fixes the QA finding that the umbrella group showed as a third milestone before the backlog; the leaf statement is amended to drop the short ID and say rows show the intent. make self-check (RHIZA_ROOT unset) fails only on stale .rhiza/rendered files, which are rendered at land.
